summary.requery_protocol: Uniform rule applied to all models: cells with empty/null content (reasoning models exhausting the token budget before the ANSWER line) were re-queried ONCE at raised max_tokens (900->4000; Gemini a further 8000 with a concise-answer instruction). GPT gap cells from a mid-run crash were re-filled identically. Denominator is fixed at 70 for every model/condition; any remaining api_fail or empty/unparseable cell is scored as INCORRECT, not dropped.

element_anonymized_base_5v.note: PRIMARY arbitrator. All species rendered identically (single color/radius), geometry unchanged, canonical camera. Kills compound-identity recall directly.

gate1.rule: open-model crystal-system accuracy meaningfully above 1/7 on the contamination-controlled subset clears training; near-chance triggers render redesign first
gate1.status: CLEARS (certified via element-anonymized primary control, pre-registered asymmetric rule)
gate1.decision: Element-anonymized base accuracy 25/70=35.7% (p<0.0001 above chance) — above-chance crystal-system perception does NOT depend on compound identity, since all atoms are indistinguishable. Per the pre-registered CLEAR branch, Gate 1 CLEARS and no post-cutoff COD run is required. Restyle-only (21/70=30%, p=0.001) agrees. Rotation-only (9/70=12.9%) is at chance (p=0.87, NOT below) = viewpoint ambiguity, not memorization. Keep axis-aligned principal views + supercell; rotation-robustness is an evaluation axis.

post_cutoff_control.status: NOT RUN (asymmetric rule: anonymized cleared, so COD not needed)
post_cutoff_control.cutoff_estimate: Qwen3-VL released 2025-09-23; older Qwen3 knowledge cutoff ~Mar-Jun 2025 (web-sourced)
post_cutoff_control.data_source_note: MP last_updated/created_at are unreliable DB-build timestamps; JARVIS has no deposition date. COD reserved for the inconclusive branch only.
post_cutoff_control.deviation_from_checklist: The pasted verification checklist (item 2) mandated this run as the arbitrating experiment and (item 1) STATUS='conditional' until done. SUPERSEDED by a later live user decision: 'option 1, asymmetric pre-registered decision rule, COD only on the inconclusive branch', made after the agent showed MP/JARVIS lack reliable deposition dates. Under that user-approved rule the element-anonymized control is primary and post-cutoff is conditional on anonymization being inconclusive. Anonymization cleared, so this run is not required for the CLEAR verdict; it stays available if the asymmetric rule is rejected.

dataset_integrity.note: Verified complete after GPT gap-fill (187 cells re-added, closing a shortfall from a mid-run crash in the prior span). Recompute ran on this verified file. Earlier '~8,200' in the pre-correction finding was an undercount from the incomplete state.

nondeterminism_note.cause: Qwen3-VL-8B at temperature=0 via OpenRouter is NOT bit-deterministic (provider-side batching/routing). Verified by 3 independent passes on IDENTICAL renders.
nondeterminism_note.reconciliation: Pre- vs post-correction numerator shifts are run-to-run variance, NOT re-scoring or denominator change: (i) all logged passes used denominator=70 with parse-failures=errors; (ii) B moved 24->21 and C moved 6->9 between two independent passes on the same 70 renders, and a third pass gave B=19, C=12 — both bounce within +/-3 cells with ~70/70 parseable every pass, so C's rise is NOT retry-filling-empties and B's fall does NOT imply a denominator != 70. The reviewer's inferred mechanism (re-scoring/denominator) is refuted by the third pass.

gate1_robustness.conclusion: Gate 1 CLEAR verdict is invariant to non-determinism: anonymized control is above chance (p<0.01) in EVERY single pass and p~3e-13 pooled.

query_accounting.empty_cell_impact_note: The base model's 259 empty cells (scored as errors, conservative for the gate) concentrate in the HARD tasks (space_group_topk 151, coordination 91), NOT crystal_system (only 4, none affecting the 5v arm materially: 2 at 3v-canonical, 1 at 3v-perturbed, 1 at 5v-canonical). The crystal-system ranking claims are therefore not distorted by empty-cell concentration; the harder-task accuracies are lower bounds.

gate1.rule: open-model crystal-system accuracy meaningfully above 1/7 on the contamination-controlled subset clears training; near-chance triggers render redesign first
gate1.decision: CLEARS (corrected). The original 'perturbed' control confounded memorization with viewpoint information loss. Decomposition shows restyle-only (the true memorization-controlled axis) leaves the base model at 34.3% (5v), well above chance 14.3%. Camera rotation off crystallographic axes causes the rest of the drop and is legitimate viewpoint ambiguity (the E0.5 identifiability limit), not memorization. Gate 1 clears; keep axis-aligned principal views in the frozen render set (already the case), and treat rotation-robustness as an evaluation axis, not a training blocker.
gate1.caveat: n=70/condition; 34.3% vs 14.3% is clearly above chance but modest — perception is weak and genuinely motivates the trained method (E2).

perturbation_decomposition_5v.note: A=canonical, B=restyle-only (axis-aligned camera, memorization probe), C=rotation-only (normal style), D=full perturbation. Base and Gemini both show rotation drives the collapse, restyle costs little.

legible_render_reprobe.note: Axis-colored-cell legible render (single cell, small atoms, 1024px). Did NOT lift perturbed accuracy; canonical dropped (removed supercell grid-memorization crutch). Confirms rotation—not style—is the limiter.
